title: Geometry optimization of pristine χ3 borophene
action: Construct a 2×3 supercell of χ3 borophene (lattice constants a=8.41 Å, b=2.93 Å, 49 B atoms, hexagon-hole pattern) with a vacuum layer >15 Å. Perform DFT geometry optimization until forces and energy converge. Save the optimized atomic coordinates.
description: Optimize the pristine χ3 supercell to obtain the reference structure for all subsequent calculations.

title: NEB calculation of Li migration on pristine χ3
action: On the optimized pristine supercell, place a Li atom at a hollow center site and compute NEB energy profiles for the vertical (Path I) and horizontal (Path II) migration directions. Record the initial-state (IS) and transition-state (TS) adsorption energies for each path.
description: Compute reference Li-ion migration barriers on pristine χ3 borophene; the IS and TS energies are required input for the final comparison.

title: Iodine adsorption on χ3 borophene
action: Place an I atom at the T2 site (top of a B atom at a hexagon corner) on the optimized pristine supercell. Fully relax the atomic positions to obtain the optimized I-χ3 geometry.
description: Generate the I-doped χ3 structure that serves as the host for Li-ion migration calculations.

title: Lithium adsorption on I-χ3 borophene
action: On the optimized I-χ3 supercell, place Li atoms at the H1, H7, and H2 hollow sites (sites close to I) and optimize each configuration to obtain the initial-state (IS) structures and energies for the migration endpoints.
description: Determine the Li adsorption energies and optimized geometries of Li at the relevant hollow sites on I-doped χ3, which are the initial states for the scored NEB calculations.

title: NEB for Li migration on I-χ3 and compile final results
action: Using the optimized I-χ3 supercell and the Li IS structures from step 04, perform NEB calculations for the paths H1→H7 and H1→H2. Record the IS and TS adsorption energies. Combine these with the pristine IS/TS energies obtained in step 02 and write a single JSON file containing all eight values (in eV).
description: Collect IS and TS adsorption energies for pristine Path I, pristine Path II, I-doped H1→H7, and I-doped H1→H2. The checker recomputes migration barriers and scores against paper gold values and trends.
output_schema: {"pristine_pathI_IS_ads": float (eV), "pristine_pathI_TS_ads": float, "pristine_pathII_IS_ads": float, "pristine_pathII_TS_ads": float, "I_H1_H7_IS_ads": float, "I_H1_H7_TS_ads": float, "I_H1_H2_IS_ads": float, "I_H1_H2_TS_ads": float, "units": "eV"}
